info.title: PromptBranch Team API
info.description: PB-TEAM-1 team workspace protocol. All paths are relative to /api/team/v1. Responses may add fields in additive contract revisions; unknown discriminated entity, command or event kinds must be refused by clients.

get.summary: Server discovery: protocol, identity, features and limits.
Current human user and joined workspaces.

delete.summary: Self-service account deletion with confirmed email.

get.summary: Server-authored cache identity for the caller (human or agent).
Workspaces the caller belongs to.

post.summary: Create a workspace; the creator becomes its sole owner.

get.summary: Workspace with the caller's freshly resolved role and generation.
Approved catalogue browse/search; summary items omit revision content.
Prompt with its approved head revision.
Published revision history, newest first.
One published revision; candidates are never served here.
Workspace tags.
Workspace collections.
Proposals (contributor+; agents see only their own).
Proposal detail with exact base and candidate revisions.
Comments on a proposal.
Note and run-summary activity for a prompt.
Workspace members (owner only).
Workspace invitations without raw tokens (owner only).
Audit log without secrets or content (owner only).
Owner NDJSON export: manifest then domain entities, no credentials.
The caller's own sessions.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's own sessions.

post.summary: Revoke all of the caller's human sessions and agent tokens.

get.summary: Agent token metadata; the secret is never returned.

post.summary: Mint a workspace-scoped agent token; secret appears once.
Execute a domain command envelope; always 200 CommandReceipt on success.
Create or reuse an immutable catalogue snapshot.

get.summary: One page of an active bootstrap snapshot.
Committed catalogue changes after a cursor, in commit order.
Infrastructure readiness probe; no private data.
